patch_description:
The current model’s main parameters are its 75/25 direct-demand blend, fixed 2/4 affinity-ranked routes, pressure discount, additional low-pressure route, and reciprocal-link penalty.

This version retains those successful components but makes route selection adaptive: it removes clearly inferior candidates and adds one alternative only when its score is close to the selection boundary and the leading route. A bounded reward adjustment prevents extra candidates from increasing aggregate route incentives too much. The reciprocal penalty and constraint weight remain unchanged, isolating the route-selection improvement while preserving a compact coupling graph. Performance gains require evaluation rather than being assumed.
